findings.title: Reservation promise is neither awaited nor returned
findings.description: reserveStock(...).then(...) is fire-and-forget inside the loop, so orders.confirm runs before any reservation finishes and the OutOfStockError thrown in the callback becomes an unhandled rejection rather than failing reserveAll — orders are confirmed regardless of stock. Await each reservation (or `await Promise.all(order.items.map(...))`) before confirming.
findings.suggestion: Restore `const res = await reserveStock(...)` in the loop or await Promise.all over the reservations.
